definitions.explanation: the first child born in a family, regardless of sex

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{長子|ちょうし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: He was born as the eldest child.
It was tradition for the eldest child to inherit the household.

examples.japanese: {長子|ちょうし}⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{定|さだ}められた→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: The system of primogeniture was established by law during the Meiji era.

notes:
A formal term for the firstborn child, used in legal, historical, and academic contexts. In everyday conversation, {一番上|いちばんうえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長子|ちょうし}⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧: primogeniture (inheritance by the eldest child)
- {長子|ちょうし}⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧: eldest-child priority
- {長子|ちょうし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as the eldest child

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長男|ちょうなん}→長男：14519_chounan⟧: eldest son — specifically the firstborn male child
- ⟦{長女|ちょうじょ}→長女：14518_choujo⟧: eldest daughter — specifically the firstborn female child
- {第一子|だいいっし}: first child — a clinical or demographic term, common in medical and statistical contexts
- {跡取|あととり}り: heir, successor — the child who inherits the family name and property
